name: read_monthly_plan
description: Read the canonical current/next month intended commitment plan across loans, SIPs, stock plans, commitments, credit cards and savings. Returns source keys, due dates and totals plus a backend-calculated income surplus (positive) or shortfall (negative). Income amount stays masked: do not derive or disclose it. Range/missing/irregular income yields null comparison. This is not remaining unpaid cash flow; do not sum other datasets into these totals. Get this plan before simulating adjustments. Also returns canonical stillToPay with pendingInvesting included and pendingSavings separate; these are unpaid projections, distinct from baselineTotal. Source items include saved basis and verified loan payoff facts. No duplicated spending or settlement totals.

month.description: YYYY-MM, current or next month in profile timezone.
